title: IP, MAC, subnet, VLAN, DNS, and zone records
description: Network interface and addressing records per asset
spec:
1. Persist asset_network_interfaces with MAC, IP, subnet, VLAN, DNS name, and network zone.
2. Support multiple interfaces per asset.
3. Link interfaces to network_zones records.
4. Surface addressing data on the asset detail network section.
5. Verify create/update/delete of interfaces via API and UI.
